headline: India's Gold Loan Portfolio Surges 60.6% to ₹23.3 Lakh Crore
summary: India's outstanding gold loan portfolio surged by 60.6 percent to ₹23.3 lakh crore, with smaller cities and southern states like Tamil Nadu driving growth.
why: Gold loans are a major retail credit segment in India, reflecting household credit demand and monetization of private gold holdings.

impacts.name: Indian Financial Sector
impacts.why: Rapid expansion of gold loan portfolios drives lending revenue for domestic financial institutions.
